**What I found**

The page at `./landing/index.html` is a single self-contained file. I verified it by opening it in a browser (file://, no build step) and screenshotting top to bottom. It renders correctly and only touches the two allowed external hosts: Google Fonts (Archivo + Space Mono) and the three.js module from `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0`.

**How I know it is right**

- **Facts, nothing beyond them.** Every claim traces to `FACTSHEET.md`: title + alias, Piet Mondrian (1872–1944) Dutch painter, 1930, oil on canvas, Kunsthaus Zurich, De Stijl founded 1917 by van Doesburg and Mondrian, Neoplasticism principles (horizontal/vertical lines, red/blue/yellow, white/grey/black), the exact picture description, and the "why it matters" line. I added no outside facts.
- **Visitor leaves knowing painter, year, movement, why it matters.** Masthead names the painter, year and medium; section 02 covers De Stijl/Neoplasticism; section 03 states why it matters; the CTA links to the fact sheet's source (Wikipedia) in the footer too.

**Assumptions I made**

- The three.js import is used to render the painting recreation (the brief allows that CDN); everything else is plain HTML/CSS so the page degrades gracefully if the module fails.
- "Single file" means one `.html` with inline CSS/JS; the Google Fonts and three.js CDN links are the only external references, which the brief explicitly permits.
- I chose a clean asymmetric grid and a red CTA button with a hard black offset shadow to stay in Mondrian's idiom.

**Cleanup**

I closed the browser tab I opened. No other tabs, windows, or apps were started.
